title: ACCESS-OM2 0.1 degree global model output (interannual forcing simulation)
description:
ACCESS-OM2-01 is COSIMA's flagship high-resolution ocean-sea ice model. It uses 0.1° lateral resolution at the Equator, tripolar in the north and Mercator projection down to 65°S, with 75 vertical levels. 
                    
                    The ACCESS-OM2 global model configuration is based on that described in Kiss et al. (2020),
                    https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-13-401-2020, but with many improvements.
                    
                    This dataset was run with JRA55-do v1.4.0 interannually-varying forcing with all solid runoff converted to liquid runoff with no heat transfer. It is a 61-year spin up, from 1 Jan 1958 to 1 Jan 2019. Initial conditions are WOA13v2 potential temperature (NB: should have been conservative temperature) and practical salinity. 
                    
                    For more information on the run configuration and history, please see: https://github.com/COSIMA/01deg_jra55_iaf/tree/01deg_jra55v140_iaf
                    
                    https://github.com/COSIMA/01deg_jra55_iaf/tree/01deg_jra55v140_iaf_cycle2
                    
                    https://github.com/COSIMA/01deg_jra55_iaf/tree/01deg_jra55v140_iaf_cycle3
                    
                    https://github.com/COSIMA/01deg_jra55_iaf/tree/01deg_jra55v140_iaf_cycle4
                    
                    Outputs are described here: http://cosima.org.au/index.php/2020/07/29/data-available-0-1-1958-2018-access-om2-iaf-run/
